name: @talkivio/widget
description: Embeddable Talkivio chat widget (loader + isolated iframe app)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frame,loader,demo "vite build --watch --mode development" "vite build --watch --mode development --config vite.loader.config.ts" "vite --config vite.demo.config.ts"
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.loader.config.ts && node scripts/check-loader.mjs
